newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Global to raise funds via private placement.
newsitem.headline: Global to raise funds via private placement.

text.p: Philippines' Global Equities Inc said on Tuesday its board of directors had approved a plan to raise 347.364 million pesos through a private placement of shares.
Assistant corporate secretary Anna Melissa Rosario told the Philippine Stock Exchange that it would issue 231,576,082 shares at 1.50 pesos per share to strategic investors.
The holding company, which has stakes in an electronic firm, a cotton company, a cement manufacturing plant, and several real estate projects, did not say where it would use the proceeds of the sale.
The sale of the shares are still subject to the approval of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Global closed at 2.04 pesos per share on Tuesday.
